comment: Every check that needs the owner's PC. Single source of truth; docs/testing/LOCAL_VERIFICATION_PLAN.md is generated from it (python3 tools/checks/checks.py plan). Rules: docs/workflow/CLOUD_LOCAL_LOOP.md.

sessions.title: Session 1: gunplay and feel
sessions.setup: Load a free-roam save, go to the test range (DevTools > TELEPORT). Keep DevTools (L3+R3 or F10) handy.

sessions.title: Session 2: storage, Arsenal and gunsmith
sessions.setup: Use a save with a safehouse and a car you can park. Back up scripts/LibertyFramework/state/arsenal_iv.json first.

sessions.title: Session 3: combat effects
sessions.setup: Free roam among ambient pedestrians, gold weapons from DevTools.

sessions.title: Session 4: vehicles (LVS)
sessions.setup: A save with money near an LVS workshop.

sessions.title: Session 5: performance by eye
sessions.setup: Your usual route and settings; note resolution and other mods.

sessions.title: Session 6: long and destructive checks (optional)
sessions.setup: Back up your save and scripts/LibertyFramework/state before starting.

checks.title: Engine, SDK, mods and native core build on Windows
checks.pass: exit code 0; build.ps1 and build-core.ps1 report no errors and ray_walk_test passes as a Windows .exe
checks.proves: The Windows toolchain builds the same sources the cloud built; the native unit tests pass on the game's target (i686 Windows).

checks.title: Full offline verifier against GTAIV.exe and game archives
checks.pass: exit code 0 and 'RESULT passed=N failed=0' with no NOT-RUN
checks.proves: Every verifier section, including the 7 the cloud reports NOT-RUN: address resolution against GTAIV.exe, native names and CE hashes, the core native table, vehicle extras, gore particles in gta_core.wpfl, WeaponInfo.xml accuracies and the collapse engine's x86 hook code.

checks.title: Content compiler self-test on Windows .NET
checks.pass: exit code 0 and 'selftest: ok passed=N failed=0'
checks.proves: The content compiler behaves the same on .NET Framework as under Mono in the cloud (codecs, writer, validator).

checks.title: Texture dictionary writer rebuilds the game's own dictionaries
checks.pass: exit code 0 and 'failed=0'; rebuilt equals identical (the review session reads the whole output)
checks.proves: The from-scratch WTD writer reproduces Rockstar's dictionaries byte for byte apart from placement.
checks.unproven: That the game loads and draws a native dictionary (T028-native-texture-review).

checks.title: Blender add-on tests with builds against the game
checks.pass: exit code 0 and 'Blender add-on tests passed' (needs Blender 4.2+ configured; otherwise NOT-RUN)
checks.proves: The 9 build expectations the cloud reports NOT-RUN: template and native builds from Blender, LOD counts, previews, modifiers, collection export.

checks.title: Package and install the develop build (backup kept)
checks.pass: package-phase2.ps1 and install-phase2.ps1 exit 0; every installed file hash-verified; backup folder recorded
checks.proves: The develop build packages against the owner's game (content assets compiled on game templates) and installs cleanly. Every scenario check depends on it.

checks.title: Native DXT1 crate compiled and read back
checks.pass: report.json: status ok, textureMode native, textureFormat DXT1, textureLevels 7
checks.proves: The native writer's output for a real asset built against the game's template passes read-back.

checks.title: Native DXT5 alpha panel compiled and read back
checks.pass: report.json: status ok, textureFormat DXT5, textureLevels 6, textureQuality.psnrAlphaDb present
checks.proves: DXT5 with alpha is written and read back for a real asset.

checks.title: Drawable structure survey: geometries, shaders, LOD slots
checks.pass: exit code 0 and a JSON report; the review session reads it (no pass/fail on the numbers themselves)
checks.proves: Across the game's model archives: how many drawables use several geometries, several shaders and LOD slots 1-3, how their buffers, shader mappings, bounds and LOD distances are laid out, and whether the reader parses them all. Input for the multi-geometry/LOD writer (Session 4).
checks.unproven: Anything about how the game renders them; this is file structure only.

checks.title: Collision file inventory: types, locations, headers
checks.pass: exit code 0 and a JSON report; the review session reads it
checks.proves: Which collision-related resources the game ships (by extension and resource type), in which archives, how many, their resource versions and top-level sizes. Input for collision research (Session 5) Also propCandidates: models shipped as a drawable with a same-named bounds resource, which the raycast-objects scenario spawns.
checks.unproven: The bound structures' field meanings; those need their own probes once the inventory is known.

checks.title: Raycast and line of sight in game
checks.proves: SDK 1.1 Query.Raycast / HasLineOfSight against world, a vehicle and a ped through the real game line test; filtering and ignore semantics; no faults.
checks.pass: autopilot PASS: ground hit, open sky clear, vehicle hit and filtered, ped hit and passed through, rayto matches, line of sight both ways, faults=0; screenshots judged
checks.unproven: Objects (props with collision) are not tested in game yet (RayMask.Objects); research questions R1-R6 in docs/research/Raycast.md.

screenshots.vehicle: the spawned Admiral stands directly in front of Niko
screenshots.ped: one pedestrian stands in front of Niko, facing him

checks.title: Raycast RayMask.Objects against a vanilla prop with collision
checks.proves: RayMask.Objects in game: a script-created vanilla prop is hit as kind Object with its own handle (all kinds, and objects only), and a query that leaves objects out passes through it; the raycast link [result+0x0C] resolves objects through the object pool.
checks.pass: autopilot PASS: rayto prop all and objects both Hit kind=Object match=True; world,peds,vehicles passed>=1; faults=0; screenshot judged
checks.unproven: Only the probe's first candidate is tested; a FAIL on the first rayto may mean that model has no collision in game (the review session then tries the next candidate from the probe report) rather than a raycast fault. Authored (LCC) props need collision first (Session 5).

screenshots.prop: a vanilla prop (not a Liberty test crate) stands on the ground about 3 m in front of Niko

checks.title: Raycast research spike (raw include bits)
checks.proves: Raw line-test results per include bit for ground, sky, a vehicle and a ped: evidence for Raycast.md open questions.
checks.pass: autopilot PASS (spawns succeed); the review session reads the raydebug/raybits lines for the vehicle
checks.unproven: Research only; interpretation happens in the review session.

checks.title: SDK self-test in game (all services, raycast checks included)
checks.proves: Every Liberty.Sdk service works in game on the new core ABI 5, including the ten raycast/line-of-sight checks. Since the engine audit also: the snapshot driver read from [vehicle+0xF50] (check vehicle-driver), capability refusal, and commands after the ownership and capability changes.
checks.pass: autopilot PASS: 'selftest_done passed=N failed=0'

checks.title: Native texture dictionaries drawn in game
checks.proves: The game loads dictionaries written from scratch and draws DXT1; how gta_default treats DXT5 alpha.
checks.pass: autopilot PASS and the screenshots judged as described
checks.unproven: Alpha behaviour is an observation (translucent, cut-out or ignored); any of the three is a valid answer.

checks.title: Confirm the gold weapon identities (IDs 58/59/60)

steps: You already reported that the gold pistol (58), carbine (59) and shotgun (60) select and work.
If that is still true on this build (you will see it during the gunplay session), answer p.

checks.proves: Lets the owner mark T-007 DONE.
checks.pass: IDs 58, 59 and 60 select and fire; switching to the vanilla counterpart keeps total ammo

checks.title: Phase 1 gunplay checklist

steps: Follow docs/testing/PHASE1_PLAYTEST.md sections 1-10 (startup, DevTools, test range, free aim, gold weapons, movement/cover/vehicle, live tuning, save/load).
Skip anything you have already confirmed on an earlier build unless it looks different now.

checks.proves: Phase 1 integrated gunplay on the develop build.
checks.pass: every section behaves as the checklist describes; note any section that does not

checks.title: Gold carbine and shotgun finishes

steps: DevTools (L3+R3 or F10) > WEAPONS: give the gold carbine (59) and the gold shotgun (60).
Look at each held gun and its HUD icon; reload, aim and fire.

checks.proves: The gold finishes render.
checks.pass: both guns and icons are gold with normal-map detail, and stay gold after reload/aim/fire

checks.title: Debug overlay hit info

steps: DevTools > GUNPLAY > Debug overlay ON.
At the test range shoot a ped, then a vehicle, then a wall.

checks.proves: The debug overlay's hit reporting.
checks.pass: the Hit line shows ped with a bone number, distance and damage, then vehicle, then world/unknown; fire shows interval and RPM

checks.title: Aim profiles (free / vanilla / rejected slowdown)

steps: Follow the three steps in the task card (edit freeAim.profile in the installed gunplay.json, then DevTools > PRESETS & CONFIG > Reload config from disk).

checks.proves: Aim profile switching and rejection.
checks.pass: free: no snap or lock; vanilla: your own Auto-Aim applies; slowdown: rejected, previous profile kept

checks.title: Shoulder swap

steps: Aim on foot (L2/LT) and press L1/LB (or Z): the camera moves to the left shoulder; press again for the right.
Try it in cover and from a vehicle.

checks.proves: Shoulder swap on the CE camera.
checks.pass: smooth swap in about 0.2 s, aim and crosshair stay centred, nothing odd in cover or vehicles

checks.title: Switch weapons while aiming

steps: Carry two Arsenal weapons. Hold L2/LT and press D-pad right, then left.
Repeat crouched and out of cover; with one weapon nothing should cycle; in a vehicle it is off.

checks.proves: Weapon cycling while aiming.
checks.pass: the held weapon cycles only among carried items while aiming, without camera drop

checks.title: Per-shot shake and aim FOV

steps: Aim and fire the gold pistol, carbine and shotgun; then their vanilla counterparts.

checks.proves: Feel effects are gated to the test weapons.
checks.pass: gold weapons: subtle per-shot shake and slightly narrower aim FOV; vanilla weapons: no change

checks.title: Phase 2 gun feel: taps, bursts, spray

steps: At the range fire single shots, three-round bursts and one long carbine spray at the same distance, with gold 58/59/60.
Compare impacts with the crosshair gap; repeat moving, crouched, in cover and from a vehicle.

checks.proves: Phase 2 spread and recoil tuning.
checks.pass: tight taps, useful bursts, visibly broader long spray; impacts stay inside the displayed cone

checks.pass: each step shows the described result and log lines

checks.title: Storage prompt, trunk panel and safehouse storage

checks.proves: Phase 2 storage interaction.

steps: Play 90 seconds on your usual route, then aim and fire briefly.
Optional: PresentMon capture as in the task card (PowerShell as Administrator).
